item.description:
LeonardoMD now renews an outdated sharing service automatically after an application update, keeping existing pairings, shared-project access and permissions. The service checks its installed identity and readiness before accepting work, and an explicit decision to disable sharing remains respected.
The project library now brings local and received projects together. Origin icons distinguish local projects, projects shared from this Mac and projects received from another device. Project removal and restoration remain available with their associated recovery controls.
Spanish and English help explains the updated library and sharing behavior. This beta also retains on-demand document downloads and separate offline storage controls.
Known limitations: transfers require a reachable source Mac; automatic refresh runs while the receiving app is active. This macOS download supports Apple silicon. Little Leonardo distribution is managed separately through TestFlight.

## Clearer file selection and readable Leonardo filenames
The active file stays highlighted in the project explorer, including MDLF, MDLR and MDLZ, even when automatic following is turned off. Selection uses the system highlight with readable text and icons.
Leonardo filenames retain their wine color in light appearance and use a brighter tint in dark appearance. The English and Spanish guides explain selection and automatic following separately; existing personal guide copies remain intact.
This beta is for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Candidate-specific installed update and relaunch acceptance remains pending.
